Name: Golden Chickens
Author: GraceTheChicken
Description:
This mod allows you to have golden chickens!
Note: The brown and white chicken files look the same, it is not recommended that you download both or it'll be hard to differentiate your white chickens from your brown chickens. This mod doesn't change baby chickens or eggs.
[b][u]
Installation:[/u][/b]
[b]RECOMMENDED:[/b] Backup the file of either your brown or white chicken, depending on which you are downloading.
1. Unzip your file.
2. Navigate to your  [code]Stardew Valley\Content\Animals[/code] folder.
3. Copy and paste the xnb file of your new chicken into the folder.
4. Replace the file.
5. Launch Stardew Valley and enjoy!
